lines.text: By the way, the party starts at seven.

data.define: Used to add a new, related thought in a talk.

example.text: By the way, the party starts at seven.

misuse.text: Don't use 'by the way' for your main point.
misuse.why: It signals a minor, extra comment.

data.l1_hook: ¡Oh, by the way, una cosa más!
data.l1_ex: By the way, la fiesta empieza a las siete.

native.tip: “by the way” = por cierto; a propósito. Ejemplo: “By the way, the party starts at seven.”
native.caption:
¿Qué significa “by the way”?
“by the way” = por cierto; a propósito.
Ejemplo: “By the way, the party starts at seven.” (By the way, la fiesta empieza a las siete.)
